entity_type.description: The high-level category of the entity acting as the issuer

trust_scopes.description: The trust contexts for which this issuer is recognized

data.description: PEM-encoded X.509 certificate used for document signing

format.description: Format of the certificate (currently only PEM is supported)

trust_lists.description: The trust lists under which this certificate is recognized (e.g., uv, aamva_dts)

certificates.description: Array of certificates issued with the same subject key identifier, ordered by X.509 notBefore descending, then notAfter descending, then PEM content as a deterministic tie-breaker. It is expected that only one certificate per subject is present, so if only updating the expiration date, the old certificate should be removed when adding the new one. This array may become empty when an issuer loses all current trust-list support due to how minor-version caching works.

signature.description: Signature over the canonicalized JSON, excluding this field
